title: Science Tonight on Instagram: "The AI reporter finally revealed why they are drinking so much water!

classification.theory_summary: Argues against using AI images in dream studies because AI imagery can contaminate/warp human memory and compromise comparisons of shared recurring dream experiences.
classification.skip_reason: No dream narrative or specific dream locations/events described; content is an argument about AI imagery affecting memory and dream-study data quality.

meta.author_theory: Recommends doodling/describing dreams rather than using AI recreations; claims viewing AI images can introduce non-experiential visual data into memory and influence subsequent dream content, undermining attempts to compare shared recurring dream experiences.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no first-person dream report, no described Mall World locations, no sensory qualities (light, cleanliness, crowding), no entities, and no in-dream actions. External link referenced but no image/map content provided here to analyze.
